_doc: Backend operations exposed by atlases/inversion/server/popstats_server.py. ENDPOINTS AND REQUEST SHAPES ARE THE REAL ONES — derived from the FastAPI route definitions in the server source. Do NOT invent endpoints; if a layer needs server compute, the endpoint must already exist in popstats_server.py.
_persist_contract_v2: Layer entries with source: operation may set persist: true. When set, every successful operation result is written to disk via Registry.write under _cache/server_results/{op_id}/{hash}.json (the logical path; the server rewrites _cache/server_results/ to the configured filesystem root, default /mnt/e/inversion-atlas-cache/server_results/). The persist hook is registry-side, fire-and-forget after the result is returned to the caller. Operations without persist: true behave exactly as before (in-memory cache only, no disk write).

_server_audit_origin._note: If you add a new operation here, the corresponding @app.post or @app.get must already exist in popstats_server.py, or you must add it as a separate task.

_server_connection_doc: The server runs on LANTA. Reach it via SSH tunnel: 'ssh -L 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 lanta'. See atlases/inversion/server/SERVER_README.md.

popstats_groupwise._doc: FST + dXY + theta_pi for arbitrary group compositions. Server computes content-addressable hash internally (sha256 of chrom+region+sorted-groups+metrics+win+step+binary_hash); we mirror that for client-side cache key. Up to 10 groups per request. Group names match [A-Za-z0-9_]+. Members validated against canonical sample list.

popstats_hobs_groupwise._doc: Per-group HoverE via Mérot-patched ANGSD. First request for a novel group composition triggers ANGSD run (~5–15s per group). Subsequent same-composition requests <100ms server-side.

ancestry_groupwise_q._doc: Reads precomputed instant_q Q-matrix and aggregates per group. Pure file I/O + pandas group-by; ~50ms uncached, <10ms cached. K=8 is the canonical value per memory.

ld_split_heatmap._doc: Pearson r-squared across BEAGLE-imputed dosages, computed by the C engine. Used by page 3 LD panel. See engines/fast_ld/README.md.

shelf_ld_test._doc: Server-side shelf LD test. Note: server returns 501 in early builds — atlas does this in JS preferentially. Check current behavior before relying on this endpoint.

dosage_chunk._doc: Chromosome-wide dosage chunk for a region. Used by per-sample lines panel and by the local PCA pipeline. Reads from dosage_dir (configured in popstats_server.config.yaml).

dosage_manifest._doc: Lists all available dosage chunks by chromosome. Loaded once at app start.

health._doc: Reports engine versions + cache stats. Used by atlas's status badge in the toolbar (the green/red dot). Polled every 30s.

operations._debug_endpoints_doc: The following are debug-only endpoints, exposed via /api/cache/* and /api/jobs/*. They are not registered as registry operations because pages don't consume them — they're for the developer console only. See popstats_server.py lines 1423-1452.

_engines_referenced._doc: These are the C/C++ engines the server invokes. Most live OUTSIDE the atlas package (in the toolkit's unified_ancestry/ tree on the LANTA cluster). Only fast_ld ships inside the atlas because it's small and inversion-specific. See atlases/inversion/server/popstats_server.config.example.yaml for path configuration.
